instruction: I'm reviewing my colleague's course outline document and would like to emphasize the final paragraph. Could you please apply bold formatting to all the text in the last paragraph?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
